items.prompt:
Earth's natural resources are distributed:
A) Evenly everywhere
B) Unevenly
C) Only at the poles
D) Only in the ocean

steps: Resources are concentrated unevenly across Earth.

items.prompt:
Which is a fossil fuel?
A) Coal
B) Granite
C) Water
D) Sand

What determines where a resource is found?
A) The weather today
B) Past geologic processes
C) The time of year
D) Random chance

How did fossil fuels form?
A) Overnight
B) From ancient organisms buried and changed over millions of years
C) From falling rain
D) From melted metal
items.answer: B) From ancient organisms buried and changed over millions of years

steps: Fossil fuels formed from ancient organisms over millions of years.

items.prompt:
Why are coal and oil found only in certain places?
A) They move around
B) The conditions that formed them occurred only in certain places
C) They form everywhere equally
D) They are made in factories
items.answer: B) The conditions that formed them occurred only in certain places

steps: Their formation conditions were local, so they are found only in some places.

items.prompt:
Groundwater collects:
A) In the air
B) In rock that can hold and move water
C) In the Sun
D) Only in oceans
items.answer: B) In rock that can hold and move water

steps: Certain rocks store and move groundwater.

items.prompt:
Why do countries trade natural resources?
A) Resources are everywhere
B) Resources are unevenly distributed, so no place has all of them
C) Trade is required by weather
D) Resources never run out
items.answer: B) Resources are unevenly distributed, so no place has all of them

steps: Uneven distribution means places must trade for resources they lack.

items.prompt:
How does understanding geology help locate resources?
A) It predicts the weather
B) It reveals where past processes formed and concentrated resources
C) It changes the resources
D) It has no use
items.answer: B) It reveals where past processes formed and concentrated resources

steps: Geology shows where past processes concentrated resources.
